orbit.starbridge.title: Orbital helm
orbit.starbridge.leave_tip: Walk around your ship. Use the bridge again to resume the view.
orbit.starbridge.home_tip: Your last departure berth is selected for the return.
orbit.starbridge.site_tip: Click a landing coordinate. The server checks terrain when you request descent.
orbit.starbridge.assist: Cruise lines up with the body and slows to entry speed.
orbit.starbridge.approach_required: Close the distance and reduce speed on the landing display.
orbit.starbridge.no_fuel: Add fuel at the bridge. Landing and return energy is reserved.
orbit.starbridge.leave_cabin: The helm is paused. Return aboard and reopen the bridge.
orbit.starbridge.board: Assemble your rocket, then board its fixed cabin to use the orbital helm.
orbit.starbridge.already: This ship already has a course. Reopen the bridge to resume it.
orbit.starbridge.launch_fuel: Add fuel for powered flight, landing and the return trip.
orbit.starbridge.no_pilot: Only the captain of this orbital flight can take the helm.
orbit.starbridge.human: The captain has claimed manual control.
orbit.starbridge.site: Choose a coordinate inside the landing grid.
orbit.starbridge.bounds: The hull survey exceeds its supported bounds.
